from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u041/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c3ed229b.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # The rightmost object above the divider is placed above the lower pattern.
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row))
    top = grid[:divider]
    bottom = grid[divider+1:]
    colors = {v for row in top for v in row if v not in (0, 5)}
    color = max(colors, key=lambda c: max(j for row in top for j,v in enumerate(row) if v == c))
    cells = [(r, j) for r,row in enumerate(top) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    r0, c0 = min(r for r,c in cells), min(c for r,c in cells)
    shape = [(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells]
    # Find lower pattern bounds and center both components on the same column.
    bcells = [(r,j) for r,row in enumerate(bottom) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    br0, bc0 = min(r for r,c in bcells), min(c for r,c in bcells)
    out = [[0]*15 for _ in range(9)]
    width = max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    bwidth = max(c-bc0 for r,c in bcells)+1
    left = (15-width)//2
    bleft = (15-bwidth)//2
    for r,c in shape:
        out[r][left+c] = color
    for r,c in bcells:
        out[3+(r-br0)][bleft+(c-bc0)] = bottom[r][c]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'))
